title: Design System: ARRA Oracle GrokBot Bridge

headline.purpose: Shared focused-task heading; local sign-in heading is not a display scale.

title.purpose: Shared section headings; toolbar uses a local compact variant.

body.purpose: 14px-root system text and common control inheritance.

body-message.purpose: Whitespace-preserving message text with a more open line height.

label.purpose: Visible creation field label, paired with required or optional metadata.

label-button.purpose: Shared primary and secondary button text.

metadata.purpose: Receipts, timestamps, and subordinate status text.

code.purpose: Operation IDs, endpoints, and source paths; wraps anywhere.

motion.name: drawer-reveal
motion.purpose: Native mobile dialog enters from translateX(-100%) using @starting-style; the only authored transition.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Sets scroll-behavior to auto and removes transitions and animations with !important.

focus.passwordGroup: focus-within outline; inner password input has no separate outline

tokenSource.aliasPolicy: Other frontmatter tokens are extracted documentation aliases, not added CSS custom properties. Local component values remain in snippets.

previewPolicy.tonalRamps: All eight-step OKLCH ramps are synthesized dark-to-light panel previews at the source hue and chroma. They are not implemented color tokens or approved replacements. Frontmatter is normative.
previewPolicy.components: Static self-contained previews extracted from implemented patterns. No snippet calls an API or proves live behavior; rem-based type is resolved against the implemented 14px root. Declared root tokens use live var() references with literal fallbacks.
previewPolicy.scope: No shipping raster assets or generated comp; review screenshots are evidence only.

localChecks: Escape dismissal and trigger focus return

components.name: New bot rail action

components.name: Send button

components.name: Labeled input
components.description: Creation field with required metadata, placeholder, keyboard focus, and muted disabled text.
components.css: .ds-field { font: 400 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #eeecee); } .ds-field-label { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 12.6px; font-weight: 550; margin-bottom: 9px; } .ds-field-meta { font-size: 11.2px; color: var(--muted, #aaa7ad); font-weight: 400; } .ds-field-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #303034); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface, #222225); color: var(--ink, #eeecee); font: 400 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; caret-color: var(--accent, #eea0c6); } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: var(--faint, #96939b); opacity: 1; } .ds-field-input:disabled { color: var(--muted, #aaa7ad); } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #eea0c6); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 430px) { .ds-field-input { font-size: 16px; } }

components.css: .ds-workspace-nav { display: grid; gap: 3px; padding: 16px; background: var(--sidebar, #19191b); font: 400 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 11px 13px; color: var(--muted, #aaa7ad); border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link svg { flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: var(--surface, #222225); color: var(--ink, #eeecee); } .ds-nav-link.ds-active { background: #2c2b2f; color: var(--ink, #eeecee); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #eea0c6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Verification receipts
components.description: Two independent preview states, not a real conversation or proof of a remote reply.
components.html:
Delivery not confirmed
Reply verified
Message details

Checks read the transcript. They never send the message again.
components.css: .ds-receipt-examples { color: var(--muted, #aaa7ad); font: 400 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-receipt { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 12px; font-size: 11.2px; } .ds-receipt svg { flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-unconfirmed { color: var(--caution, #dcc098); } .ds-verified { color: var(--positive, #b1c4a0); } .ds-check { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-left: auto; padding: 3px 0; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: none; color: var(--accent, #eea0c6); font: 400 11.9px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-check:hover:not(:disabled) { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-check:disabled { opacity: .48; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-receipt-details { margin-top: 9px; font-size: 10.78px; } .ds-receipt-details summary { color: var(--muted, #aaa7ad); cursor: pointer; width: fit-content; } .ds-receipt-details summary:hover { color: var(--ink, #eeecee); } .ds-receipt-details[open] summary { margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-receipt-details p { margin: 0; font-size: 11.06px; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-check:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #eea0c6); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-receipt-details summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #eea0c6); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
A quiet, dark workspace with the familiarity of native chat. Charcoal planes, off-white system typography, compact letter avatars, and restrained pink actions keep attention on conversations rather than infrastructure. The interface is direct and lightly rounded, with open canvas around focused work instead of decorative card grids.

Identity comes from the authored bridge mark, the exact name **ARRA Oracle GrokBot Bridge**, and consistent action and status treatments. The approved world is flat and code-led: no gradients, glow, decorative metrics, or generated mockup. The surface-specific composition and task sequence remain in `.impeccable/surfaces/src-app-tsx.md`; this file records how the completed implementation expresses that world.
keyCharacteristics: Near-neutral charcoal layers and quiet hairline separators.
Pink for actions and focus; olive and amber for textual state feedback.
Compact system typography, sentence-case controls, and authored stroke icons.
Sidebar-first navigation, focused content widths, and a bottom-anchored composer.
Visible distinction between a submission, an uncertain operation, and a verified record.

rules.name: The State Has Words Rule
rules.body: A status dot or semantic color accompanies a readable state label; color alone never distinguishes submitted, unavailable, or verified.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tonal separation and quiet rules for existing workspace surfaces; do not add glow, gradients, or elevation shadows to reproduce this system.

rules.name: The Receipt Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Reserve verified language for a checked record; neither a submitted request nor a connected browser establishes a remote reply.

dos: **Do** retain the exact product name, charcoal world, native-chat typography, and authored SVG icon language.
**Do** keep action, unavailable, and verified treatments visually distinct and pair states with readable text.
**Do** preserve per-bot drafts and stable operation details through uncertainty; keep reconciliation actions separate from submission.
**Do** keep every navigation action reachable in the mobile dialog and short-window scrolling rail.
**Do** retain source and line provenance for history and visibly identify synthetic proof as synthetic.
**Do** use the shipped CSS and component state logic as the source when refreshing these extracted tokens and snippets.
donts: **Don't** add glow, gradients, decorative metrics, or raised card grids to this workspace world.
**Don't** treat an unavailable remote as failed owner authentication, an empty bot roster, or lost local history.
**Don't** label gateway acceptance as a verified reply or a profile check as native-window selection proof.
**Don't** disable draft editing merely because sending or creation is unavailable.
**Don't** promote fixture screenshots, panel preview snippets, or generated tonal-ramp previews into evidence of live remote success or public deployment.
**Don't** generalize local heading treatments, isolated optical values, or small icon-button dimensions into new universal design requirements.
